readings: Match each telescope to its observatory on observstation, excluding unmatched telescopes. Group the matched telescopes by observatories.lunarstage, with NULL as its own group. For each group, calculate the average of non-NULL telescopes.bandusagepct values and count all matched telescopes in the group, including those with NULL bandusagepct. Calculate the unweighted mean of the non-NULL group averages, and keep groups whose average exceeds that mean. Return one unrounded row containing the average of the kept group averages, the sum of their telescope counts, and the average of their group averages minus the mean.

Match each telescope to its observatory on observstation, excluding unmatched telescopes. Group the matched telescopes by observatories.lunarstage, with NULL as its own group. For each group, calculate the average of non-NULL telescopes.bandusagepct values and count only telescopes with non-NULL bandusagepct. Calculate the unweighted mean of the non-NULL group averages, and keep groups whose average exceeds that mean. Return one unrounded row containing the average of the kept group averages, the sum of their telescope counts, and the average of their group averages minus the mean.
queries:
WITH lunar_groups AS (
    SELECT
        o.lunarstage,
        AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS group_avg,
        COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
    FROM telescopes AS t
    JOIN observatories AS o
        ON t.observstation = o.observstation
    GROUP BY o.lunarstage
),
group_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(group_avg) AS mean_avg
    FROM lunar_groups
)
SELECT
    AVG(g.group_avg) AS average_band_usage,
    SUM(g.telescope_count) AS telescope_count,
    AVG(g.group_avg) - m.mean_avg AS difference_from_mean
FROM lunar_groups AS g
CROSS JOIN group_mean AS m
WHERE g.group_avg > m.mean_avg

WITH lunar_groups AS (
    SELECT
        o.lunarstage,
        AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS group_avg,
        COUNT(t.bandusagepct) AS telescope_count
    FROM telescopes AS t
    JOIN observatories AS o
        ON t.observstation = o.observstation
    GROUP BY o.lunarstage
),
overall_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(group_avg) AS mean_avg
    FROM lunar_groups
)
SELECT
    AVG(g.group_avg) AS average_bandwidth_usage,
    SUM(g.telescope_count) AS telescope_count,
    AVG(g.group_avg - m.mean_avg) AS average_above_mean
FROM lunar_groups AS g
CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m
WHERE g.group_avg > m.mean_avg
